message: 実は普通の女の子

name: Shio
message: 「Oh, if it isn't Lord Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Shio-chan. Good work at KiraFes.」

name: Shio
message: 「With the previous event achieving great success, it seems the Student Council is sailing smoothly.」

name: Synn
message: 「We're really only just getting started.」

name: Shio
message: 「And so, what is the next grand undertaking?」

name: Synn
message: 「As far as big events go, I'd say the Holy Night Festival in December.」

name: Shio
message: 「The Holy Night Festival, you say! That is an event I have yet to experience myself. I look forward to seeing how it unfolds.」

name: Synn
message: 「Talk about pressure\s01」

name: Shio
message: 「Still, 'holy night' truly has a sweet, heart-fluttering ring to it...」

name: Synn
message: 「Wait, Shio-chan, aren't you a shrine's daughter?」

name: Shio
message: 「Indeed I am, yet there is surely no maiden whose heart does not leap at the mention of the Holy Night.」

name: Synn
message: 「I see. So you really are a normal girl too, Shio-chan.」

name: Shio
message: 「...And what exactly do you mean by that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, nothing, I just thought it sounded pretty fairy-tale-like.」

name: Shio
message: 「Have you come here solely to mock me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「How did you jump to that conclusion!?」

name: Shio
message: 「Though I possess the spirit of a warrior, I have by no means cast aside my maiden's heart!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whoa, I'm sorry! That's not what I meant--eek!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Exciting!」

name: Synn
message: 「Lolotte...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「No drawing swords in the palace!」
She's picked up some wrong trivia again.

name: Shio
message: 「My apologies. Drawing a blade on school grounds is indeed rather reckless.」

name: Synn
message: 「It goes way beyond just 'rather reckless'...」

name: Misa
message: 「You probably just said something insensitive again and made her mad, didn't you」

name: Synn
message: 「Gulp」

name: Shio
message: 「Impressive as ever, Sister. Having read through the hearts of countless maidens, you have thoroughly mastered the essence of pure love」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Please teach me toooo!」

name: Misa
message: 「I-I told you, I don't know anything about that!」
